title: AuthorityChangedPayload
description: Payload of the AuthorityChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

changeKind.description: What kind of authority change this is.

validity.description: The validity window of the change.

to.description: End of validity, absent when open-ended.

authorityVersion.description: Monotonic authority version this change advances to.
